Vulnerability Description: V-222387 (SV-222387r879511_rule): The application must limit the number of concurrent sessions to an organization-defined number.
Milestone Description: Configure the application to limit the number of concurrent sessions per account.
Comments: No concurrent-session limit is configured; unlimited sessions per account.

Vulnerability Description: V-222388 (SV-222388r879589_rule): The application must transmit only encrypted representations of passwords.
Milestone Description: Configure the application to transmit passwords only over TLS.
Comments: Login form posts credentials over plain HTTP; no TLS on the auth endpoint.

Vulnerability Description: V-222390 (SV-222390r879887_rule): The application must use FIPS-validated cryptographic modules for all cryptographic operations.
Milestone Description: Configure the application to use only FIPS-validated cryptographic modules and cipher suites.
Comments: TLS offers a non-FIPS cipher suite (CHACHA20); no FIPS mode enforced.
